scenario: LSER.17.2 / LSER.19.8 — `direction` returns `Int?`, so emitting `t.direction` into an `Int?` slot compiles with no rescue: the leaf agrees ([LEXP.7.3b]) and a nullable slot is not a concrete-value position ([LNUL.5.1]). The positive half of compiler/LSER.17.2_direction_into_string_slot. A compiler that types `direction` as `String` refuses this program; one that refuses every series read at an emit slot passes the negative half and fails here. PATH PINNED: `dsc.typecheck.luni_9_1_agg_type`'s `direction` arm and `dsc.validate.lexp_7_3b_kwarg_type` admitting an Int leaf into an Int slot.
rules_ds:
use default

schema Sensor scope logical:
    entity_id: String key
    state: Float mutable

schema Out scope logical:
    k: String key
    d: Int? mutable

series Sensor.state:
    direction sliding 10_s

rule r:
    Sensor t
->
    emit Out logical k: t.entity_id d: t.direction
